notes.caption_max: Meta developer docs state 2200 characters for a caption.
notes.hashtag_max: Instagram capped posts and Reels at 5 hashtags on 18 December 2025. The API reference still mentions 30. The app limit is 5.
notes.feed_preview_chars: Instagram does not publish the exact feed cut. 125 is the usual desktop window before ... more. Treat it as a guide.
notes.mention_max: Meta developer docs state 20 @ mentions in a caption.
notes.stale: If Instagram disagrees with this file, Instagram is right. Update the numbers and the checked date.
